messages:
maya: Quick q — where do folks look for prefix/kv cache hit-rate dashboards + traces? I'm seeing a jump in misses for /v1/generate and want the right panel + logs to triage, and who to ping about alert thresholds.
sam: Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd123/kv-prefetch-overview — the top row has hit-rate, per-model breakdown, and eviction panels. Preface: panel names include 'KV Prefetch Hitrate' and 'Prefix-level Hitrate (by prefix)'.
sam: For traces use jaeger at https://jaeger.redwood.internal/search. Search by request-id or resource = runtime/generate. If you have a request id drop it here and I can pull the trace.
sam: Quick Loki snippet for logs (copy into Explore -> Logs):
```
{app="runtime", job="inference"} | json | request_id="req-abc123" | line_format "[${level}] ${msg} ${prefix}"
```
This shows per-prefix misses and eviction messages.
lee: Alert owner is eng-platform oncall (rotation). The alert currently is `kv_prefetch_miss_rate > 0.15 for 5m` in ops-alerts. That rule is noisy with cold starts so we should consider a higher threshold or a warm-up suppression.
maya: Nice, I have a sample req: req-abc123. Can you pull the trace, @sam? Also I'll open a small PR to propose changing the alert to 0.25 and add a suppressed_by_label for cold_start=true.
sam: Got it — pulling trace now. Early look: there's a burst of serdes time and a KV miss storm from a single prefix (prefix="chat-short-session"). Suggest we add a grafana panel that shows top N prefixes by miss rate (5m).
sam: PromQL we use for the panel:
```
sum(rate(kv_prefetch_miss_total{env="prod"}[5m])) by (prefix) / sum(rate(kv_prefetch_total{env="prod"}[5m])) by (prefix)
```
use `topk(10, ...)` to show the top offenders.
lee: If you want to split alerts, we could switch to a per-prefix alert (only alert if miss_rate>0.2 and requests > 100/s) to avoid driving noise from low-volume prefixes.
oncall-bot: [alert] ops-alerts: kv_prefetch_miss_rate fired 3 times in last 10m. Alert link: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alerts/1112
maya: Thanks all — @sam please paste the trace link when you have it. I'll draft the alert-tuning PR and tag @lee for review. Will also add the new topk panel to the preftech dashboard. :thumbsup:
sam: Trace link: https://jaeger.redwood.internal/trace/4f2b9c (span shows repeated kv.get -> 404 -> fallback path). Looks like a short-lived traffic shift to a new model shard.
maya: OK that maps to a recent rollout — I'll roll back the canary and watch the hit-rate. I'll update here when stable.
lee: Sweet. If it reappears after rollback we should open a postmortem.
maya: Will do. Thanks everyone.
